production.note: Calendar years. Quote (Jaguar): "The first customer car was completed in June 1992 with a retail price of £470,000. Production ceased in 1994, by which time 275 cars had been built." Evo panel: "Years made: 1992-1994". Not sold new in the US: an RM Sotheby's lot (rmsothebys-xj220-us-1993) describes a car brought in through an individual "EPA and DOT conversion", so the home (UK) market is used.

displacementL.note: 3,498 cc (Evo panel); Jaguar: "3.5‑litre, twin turbo V6".

drivetrain.note: "channelled its drive through the 18‑inch Speedline rear wheels"

transmission.note: "five‑speed gearbox and an AP Racing twin‑plate clutch"; PistonHeads: "5-speed manual, rear-wheel drive".

powerHp.note: Jaguar's 550 PS x 0.98632 = 542 hp. Quote (Jaguar): "The XJ220 developed 550 PS and 475 lbs ft of torque to allow it to accelerate to 60mph in under four seconds." Evo panel: "Max power: 542bhp @ 7200rpm".

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (unlabelled basis). Jaguar figure: 1,470 kg x 2.20462 = 3,241 lb. Quote (Jaguar, prose): "Constructed using advanced aluminium honeycomb, the car was immensely strong and, despite its size, weighed just 1,470 kg." Jaguar does not say whether this is kerb or dry, and no panel labelled kerb (Autocar, Evo, Jaguar brochure) was found. PistonHeads' buying-guide panel (Tony Middlehurst) gives "Weight: 1,456kg", within 1%; Top Gear Philippines (topgear-ph-xj220) gives 1,470 kg; neither is labelled kerb.

discrepancies.reason: Jaguar gives 1,470 kg; PistonHeads' buying-guide panel gives 1,456 kg (about 1% less). Likely rounding or a different car/configuration; neither labels it kerb or dry.
PistonHeads prints "550hp", which is Jaguar's 550 PS figure labelled as hp.
discrepancies.resolution: Used Jaguar's 550 PS converted to 542 hp, matching Evo's 542bhp.

reviewNotes: Weight basis unknown: Jaguar's 1,470 kg is in prose and unlabelled; a labelled kerb figure (Autocar or Evo panel, Jaguar brochure) would confirm it.
provisionalNote: Weight (3,241 lb) is provisional: it rests on Jaguar's unlabelled prose figure of 1,470 kg, supported by PistonHeads' unlabelled 1,456 kg (within 1%). A kerb weight labelled as such in a Jaguar brochure or an Autocar/Evo specification panel would replace it. Power (Jaguar 550 PS, Evo 542bhp) is not provisional.
